claims.text: Google's Aug 20 Antigravity blog states inclusion in eligible Gemini Enterprise subscriptions (Standard/Plus) with admin enablement.
The Cloud blog (Aug 21, no clock time) adds IDE extensions (VS Code, JetBrains/VS/Zed previews), pooled token quotas, budget caps, audit logging, and sandbox/MCP/browser controls.

limitations.text: Cloud-blog dating is Aug 21 without time; position vs 22:00Z cutoff is a stated precision limit, though the Aug 20 Antigravity post independently carries the bundle.
limitations.context: Evidence boundary retained for downstream editorial use.

limitations.text: Plan-eligibility edge cases beyond Standard/Plus/emerging-market require console verification.
limitations.context: Evidence boundary retained for downstream editorial use.
